PDF Cell-projection Parallel Volume Rendering With Early Ray Termination
For this system, the modified early ray termination scheme is proposed to prune the cell-projection of invisible cell. In order to alleviate load imbalance due to view-dependency in scan-conversion and the dynamic behavior of early-ray termination, the authors also implement dynamic load bal-ancing mechanism into their system.
